Government tenders: monitoring and bid preparation

Tenders that fit your company arrive in Telegram every day, and deadlines and document lists are never missed. An MVP in 4–8 weeks, from UZS 60 mln; the full version in 10–16 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Collection of public tenders from the national procurement portals
  • AI matching to your profile and keywords
  • Daily Telegram digest
  • Deadline calendar
What the full version adds
  • Document checklist per tender
  • Draft bid documents from templates
  • Price history from published results
  • Team workflow and approvals
  • Win and loss analytics
Please note

Uses public data only; bids are submitted by your own staff with your E-IMZO key.

What we need from you

  • How the work runs today and sample documents
  • Existing data: Excel or an old system
  • Staff to try the system
  • One person who makes the decisions
